site_intro: The following plates take apart the research entry on the home page, as published, at two screen widths. The tinted rules are annotations.
layout_note: Read the numbered anchors against the same entry below. At the wider size, the index, description and evidence occupy different tracks. At the narrow size, the evidence moves below the description.
type_intro: The words and computed settings of the desktop entry above, in the faces the browser drew. The samples keep the measured typeface, size and tracking but use looser line spacing so that they can reflow; both line heights are listed where they differ.
site_end: Other pages use the same grid differently. Here the rule separates projects, the number locates the entry, and the narrower evidence column carries the status and data behind the title.
pv_intro: A B3 specimen made by the current shop renderer: one copy, Traditional Chinese, base pixel type at 24 dots, no translation, simulated cash payment. The annotation follows the output from receipt to poem.
anatomy_note: The strip below joins the shop’s receipt, the CUT HERE segment and the poem image in the order they are output, all at one scale. Numbered leaders identify the printed fields.
callouts: The centred masthead gives way to store, till, operator, date and order fields. The order reference belongs to the transaction as a whole.
Quantity and description start at fixed character positions; unit price and amount align to the right. A long description continues on the following line.
The total doubles the vertical dot scale while retaining the same character advance. The cash scene records tender and change.
The barcode and reference identify this generated scene, followed by the printed notice that the purchase is fictional.
CUT HERE occupies its own segment between the receipt and the poem. One order can continue with more numbered poem copies.
Author, title, poem, source and copy number form a separate reading document. Its identifier extends the order reference; its text does not repeat the price.
geometry_intro: Three nested widths govern this output: the PDF paper model, the raster image, and the text with its own insets. The PDF centres the image with 5 mm on each side.
dots_note: Millimetres are calculated at 8 dots per mm; the drawing is to proportion.
columns_title: 03 / A receipt is a fixed grid
columns_intro: This is the item-header crop. Four fields occupy 3, 11, 6 and 6 character cells, with one-cell separators and a final trailing cell. Every cell advances 12 dots. The receipt’s letters come from the renderer’s own bitmap patterns.
glyph_note: The A pattern: 5 × 7 source cells. Each filled cell becomes 2 × 2 output dots; the advance is 12 dots and the normal line step is 24. For the total, the filled cells become 2 × 4 dots and the line step becomes 48.
font_intro: The same first lines of B3, at a 24-dot body setting and the same 352-dot text measure. These crops come from two shop configurations with no translations. The website-typeface option adds a charge and changes only the letterforms.
font_note: The base uses Fusion Pixel Zh HK on its 12-dot grid, with 32-dot line steps here. The website setting uses the project’s CJK serif stack with 31-dot line steps here. Both crops are one-bit output; the different silhouettes and spacing are visible in the pixels.
detail_note: Open an image to see its original pixels; enlargements keep the hard edges.
specimen: B3 / 24 September 2026 / one copy / no translation
original: Original text remains available on the poem page.
